summary: Pre-market 2026-11-04: the global risk score is 63.24, still high_risk and 0.22 points above the 2026-11-03 close of 63.02, but hardly any of that is a price move. The last settled US session is still 2026-11-03, and the only dimension that changed was macro, up 1.14 points because the 2026-11-02 FRED vintage replaced the 2026-10-30 one (the 10-year at 4.91 from 4.94, the real 10-year at 2.62 from 2.60, 2s10s at 0.32 from 0.38); at a 20 percent weight that alone covers the whole gain. The regime stays indeterminate for a second session because no rule in the ladder fires: VIX 21.15 is under the 28 gate, HY OAS 3.43 is under 5.0, the curve at 0.32 is positive but not above 0.5, cross-asset confirmation at 0.50 is under 0.55, and momentum at -2.0057 with a VIX above 20 blocks the risk_on fallback. The overnight tape was risk-on: a Democratic sweep of both chambers in the US midterms turned index futures from an initial sell-off into gains, gold rose 2.8271 percent on a softer dollar, and AMD traded 6 percent higher pre-market after earnings while memory names firmed. Asia carried the larger move: all 11 tracked A-shares rose, averaging 10.6763 percent, with 600584.SH and 002156.SZ at the 10 percent limit and 300223.SZ up 17.799 percent, a full reversal of the 2026-11-03 session mean of -7.5377 percent. Credit has confirmed none of it: HY OAS at 3.43 sits at the 87.63 percentile, breadth at 0.3742 is only 0.0242 above the 0.35 risk-off gate, and new highs cover just 0.0064 of 157 names.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation at 0.50 is 4 of 8 scoring legs, worth 7.5 points - the single largest contribution. Most of the firing legs are level conditions that were already in place: the dollar index at 121.6656 above 105, the real rate at 2.62 above 1.50, small caps 4.6594 points behind on a 63-session basis. Only gold, up 2.8271 percent, is fresh overnight, so without a new leg the dimension is a floor rather than a signal.

Liquidity and credit at 77.27 is the heaviest dimension and one of the two with a flat trend: high-yield OAS at 3.43 scores 87.63 and carries 7.0104 points on its own weight, investment grade at 0.94 scores 77.27, and the overnight reverse repo at 0.427 billion dollars scores 91.49 through the neutral deviation mapping because the facility is nearly drained. Nothing in this dimension tightened during the equity rebound.

Macro at 74.06 is the only dimension that moved, up 1.14 points, and it still leans on the 2026-11-02 rate prints: the real 10-year at 2.62 sits at the 97.67 percentile, the nominal 10-year at 4.91 at 96.87, the curve at 0.32 at 60.83. The real rate contributes 4.8835 points; the vintage is one session behind tonight's tape, so the dimension describes 2026-11-02 rather than the midterm reaction.

Volatility at 45.85 carries 5.86 points through VIX alone: 21.15 is the 2026-11-02 close, 10.01 points above realized volatility of 11.1358. Implied is pricing stress that realized moves have not delivered, which makes this the dimension with the widest two-way risk - it can fall on its own if the rally holds, or spike if the midterm reaction reverses.

Breadth at 0.3742, 58 of 155 constituents above their 200-day average, is only 0.0242 above the 0.35 risk-off gate, and leadership is absent: new highs are 0.0064 of 157 names, new lows 0.0764, and semis relative strength is 10.3741 points behind on a 63-session basis. A single weak US session is enough to flip the regime.

supporting_signals.claim: The 2026-11-03 US session repaired the AI-hardware de-rating in one step: semis rose 2.8997, data centres 5.4303, NVDA 2.2914 and MU 2.5804, with the semiconductor ETF up 2.5019. That is the tape the sector table still shows today.

A-shares reversed the 2026-11-03 drawdown completely: all 11 tracked names rose, averaging 10.6763 percent against -7.5377 percent the day before, with 600584.SH and 002156.SZ closing at the 10 percent limit and 300223.SZ up 17.799 percent.

Crypto and realized volatility argue the same way: bitcoin at 78590 is up 1.99209 percent over 24 hours, ether is up 2.9473 percent, and realized volatility at 11.1358 sits in the 14.54 percentile - the tape is calmer than implied vol assumes.

contradicting_signals.claim: Credit never confirmed the equity rebound: high-yield OAS at 3.43 has only eased from 3.44 and still sits at the 87.63 percentile, investment grade is flat at 0.94, and reverse repo at 0.427 leaves no cash cushion. Equity risk is being repriced while credit risk is not.

The rally is narrow by construction: breadth 0.3742 with 0.0064 new highs and small caps 4.6594 points behind over 63 sessions means the move is carried by a handful of large AI names, not by the index.

Outside AI hardware the tape is still defensive: autos fell 1.3174 with Tesla down 1.3174, the EV supply chain lost 1.1345 and autonomous driving 0.5057, so the sector table's positive mean of 1.2288 rests on a single complex.

what_changed_today: The score moved 0.22 points to 63.24, entirely from the macro vintage: the 2026-11-02 FRED prints replaced the 2026-10-30 ones (10-year 4.91 against 4.94, real 10-year 2.62 against 2.60, 2s10s 0.32 against 0.38). No US price changed - the last settled session is still 2026-11-03.

Two theme rows re-pointed at the overnight Asia session: memory went from 4.0821 to -0.4132 because the last step is now SK Hynix at -0.1431 and Samsung at -0.6834 rather than the US memory complex, and consumer electronics went from 0.0477 to -0.8404 on Xiaomi at 0.5594 and Hon Hai at -2.2403. Neither is a US memory or handset signal.
Robotics still reads the 2026-11-03 US session at -0.0163: Japan was shut on 2026-11-03, so Keyence has no bar for that date and the 2026-11-04 step was skipped entirely rather than padded flat.

A-shares posted a full reversal, 10.6763 percent against -7.5377 percent on 2026-11-03; note that the 2026-11-03 post-close run republished the 2026-11-02 A-share session unchanged for all 11 names, so any comparison against that file is one session stale.

Of the 22 sector rows, 20 still describe the 2026-11-03 US close; only memory and consumer electronics re-pointed at the overnight Asia session, so the 1.2288 mean is not an overnight move but a snapshot of the 11-03 US session.
watch_next: The US cash open is the first real test: futures reversed from an overnight sell-off into gains on the midterm result, and UBER, SNAP and RIOT report today, so watch whether the bid survives contact with cash trading.
AMD's post-earnings gain puts semis relative strength, 10.3741 points behind over 63 sessions, in focus; a second leg up would be the first genuine repair of that series since the de-rating began.
Breadth at 0.3742 has only 0.0242 of cushion above the 0.35 gate, and the risk_on branch needs VIX under 20 from 21.15 - the regime can resolve either way within a single session.

Employment Situation on 2026-11-06 and CPI on 2026-11-10 are the next high-importance prints; with the real 10-year at 2.62 in the 97.67 percentile, the rate channel remains the dominant macro risk regardless of the election outcome.

bull_case.title: Bull case: breadth reclaims 0.40 and the regime resolves
points: VIX falls back under 20 from 21.15 and momentum turns positive from -2.0057, which alone flips the risk_on branch without any other input changing.
Breadth climbs from 0.3742 through 0.40, taking new highs off the 0.0064 floor and turning semis relative strength positive over 63 sessions.
One more cross-asset leg triggers, lifting confirmation above 0.50, and the 7.5-point block starts to release.

base_case.title: Base case: the score holds near 63.24 while vintages catch up
points: No ladder rule fires again: VIX 21.15, HY OAS 3.43, the curve at 0.32, cross-asset at 0.50 and momentum at -2.0057 all stay inside their bands, so indeterminate persists.
Credit stays wide at 3.43 and breadth stays just above 0.35, keeping the score in high_risk without a directional break.
The next real information is the 2026-11-06 employment report and the 2026-11-10 CPI, not the election itself.

bear_case.title: Bear case: breadth breaks 0.35 and the regime goes risk_off
points: One weak US session takes breadth from 0.3742 through 0.35, the only ladder trigger within reach, which would re-label the regime risk_off.
HY OAS at 3.43 moves toward the 5.0 liquidity-stress gate while investment grade at 0.94 stays flat, the pattern that precedes a credit-led de-rating.
The 10.01-point gap between VIX at 21.15 and realized volatility at 11.1358 closing from the top would add volatility points on top of the structural ones.
